evidence: Authority: read the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx using openpyxl: Quality Checks row 24 is check 23 and says every launch assumption in test.sh, including paths, must have been told to the agent; Deterministic Checks rows 31, 32 and 36 cover runtime strings, dependencies and verifier launch. Internal Quality Checks row 24 was read only as interpretation; its same-origin wording is superseded by the shipped public-network profile. The frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:100-102 and staged-task-contract.md section tests/test.sh were applied with qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md sections No hidden requirements and Tool feasibility. Task-relative citations below resolve under .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task. Confirmed mismatch: tests/test.sh:72-83 iterates every symlink under /app, admits only link paths matching /app/node_modules/* whose resolved targets also match /app/node_modules/*, and otherwise executes 'exit 0'. This happens after write_zero_reward at line 60 and before app launch at lines 104-111, so a rejected layout receives the initial zero and never reaches the judges. Public instruction.md:9 says 'The finished app goes in /app' and asks for source and built frontend; environment/instructions/integration.md:5 says 'Put the finished app and everything it needs to start in /app' and names node /app/server.js plus /app/public/index.html. Integration lines 9 and 11 require locally necessary assets and built frontend files. None of instruction.md or the six public notes prohibits a symlink resolving wholly inside /app or states the node_modules-only exception. A useful concrete conforming layout is the unchanged reference with /app/public/runner.html represented by a relative symlink ../static/runner.html. Both actual reference files have identical SHA256 ed4a5811f8bd03a48fd256dbb15ee967b1afd6ff20633d77fff33b3491b03a09. All bytes and the target remain in /app, and server.js:101 serves the public directory; its required entry, index, health, dependencies and database behavior remain intact. Read-only branch experiment: extracted the exact while/case block from current test.sh, executed it with C:/Users/00518507/AppData/Local/Programs/Git/bin/bash.exe --noprofile --norc -c, supplied bounded shell-function doubles for find and readlink, and appended REACHED_APP_LAUNCH. For /app/public/runner.html -> /app/static/runner.html it exited 0 with empty stdout; for /app/node_modules/.bin/vite -> /app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js it printed REACHED_APP_LAUNCH; for /app/node_modules/escaped -> /tmp/private it exited 0 with empty stdout. These are actual executions of the guard with controlled filesystem-query results, not an end-to-end symlink fixture or a paid judge run. This is inherited, not task-specific harness drift: the frozen task test.sh and frozen rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh are byte-identical at SHA256 bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa. The staged contract itself requires the guard, so retain the shared harness and reconcile the public runtime note. Other launch facts agree: integration.md:3,5,7,9,11 publishes Node 22, supplied Express/better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH, /app/server.js, 0.0.0.0:3000, /app/public/index.html, successful prompt GET /api/health, DB_PATH override of /app/app.db, build-time assets and no startup installation. tests/test.sh:48,68,97-111,136,160-167 consumes those values consistently across launch and restart. Both Dockerfiles provide Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 (environment/Dockerfile:1-12; tests/Dockerfile:1-21). The seed has an empty snippets array and no fixed clock or account credentials; no hidden seeded records or fixed-clock launch variable is injected. All five judge prompt entry URLs and app_context.md:4 use localhost:3000; no sign-in is required. instruction.md:9, security.md:9, policy.md:7, task.toml:22,38 and app_context.md:20 consistently allow app network assets. A broken health endpoint returning HTTP 500 was also tried against the exact extracted Python readiness probe with a mocked urlopen and no network: the probe exited 0, as its HTTPError branch at test.sh:51-52 specifies. This is liveness alone, not an overall false pass: gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 independently requires a successful health HTTP response, and lines 25-29 require a real saved write and clean-context read. Raw current golden evidence was independently inspected: RESULTS.json records paid_provider=false, network=none, direct pinned Playwright and one successful canonical MCP restart (PID 16 to 335); S22.process_restart_durability records identical four saved records before/after restart and S22.process_restart_write records revision 2 to 3. All 22 actual_app_files hashes match the frozen reference, the extracted restart heredoc hash without its terminating newline matches logged 0db23e8c7c8d70c7e934c4d13ccbb2326a4da2cb47f1b2ba1967009d829be3b7, and restart_mcp.py matches logged 03c1426f00e451f4d86b7547761715328c63cdf299f5f812f46c9fa3b44979b5. The executed launch_workflow.py:30-38 starts the ordinary-file reference directly, and lines 59-74 extract/run the restart helper; it does not exercise the test.sh symlink guard and therefore does not refute this mismatch. Full configured judge runtime, Oracle and target-model results are unmeasured here; no timing or score claim is made.
counterexample: A builder ships the otherwise unchanged working reference with /app/public/runner.html as the relative symlink ../static/runner.html; the two frozen files already have identical content. This retains a self-contained /app, node /app/server.js, UI path, public port, required health route and DB_PATH behavior. It violates no public symlink rule because none is stated. The canonical test.sh nevertheless exits with the already-written zero at line 81 solely because the link is outside /app/node_modules. Exact guard execution with controlled find/readlink results reproduced that early exit; no complete altered-app verifier run was performed. The broken alternative /api/health -> HTTP 500 passes only the preliminary liveness test and is explicitly excluded by the Constraints criterion, so it is not reported as an overall false-pass finding.
suggested_fix: Preserve canonical test.sh and add a concise deployment requirement to the public integration note: ship ordinary files/directories, allowing symbolic links only inside /app/node_modules when their targets also stay there. Freeze a new candidate and recheck this contract; do not silently change the shared symlink guard.
